Fix (a) — guard/memo recomposition — implemented and pushed as Gerrit change 1761 (commit d747216b833, worktree arthropods-guard-memo).

What shipped: new module src/rebar/llm/runaway_guard.py (ToolCallLedger + two-arm guard). The memo layer now reports EXECUTED work into a shared ledger (4 sites: non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-sig miss, read_file first-read, truncated fallback). The guard's ratio arm evaluates distinct-ratio over the EXECUTED stream only, so memo-served (free) repeats are no longer loop evidence; a served-streak backstop still bounds pure cache-served loops after a full window of zero-execution calls. Layer order unchanged (Guard->Memo->Steering); completion policy unaffected.

Validation: withheld-oracle TDD (regression test proven to fail on old guard), 6/6 manual mutants killed (mutation pass surfaced + filled 2 test gaps), lint/typecheck/499 LLM-area tests green.

Next (fix b, per the step-back design above): tri-state evidence banking — BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE currently banks met=false at search exhaustion; should bank insufficient_evidence instead. Will file as follow-up ticket linked discovered_from once change 1761 merges.
